_source: Read off the panoramic video scoreboard (fixed camera, crop 300:130:3170:330). Periods 1-2 are stop time, so each goal/penalty time is the moment the game clock FROZE at the scoresheet value (the whistle). Period 3 ran a continuous clock once the game was out of hand at 8-2, so those times are read directly off the running clock, which is exact rather than approximate. Times are in the published master's timeline: master = panoramic - 367.49 (7.49s feed offset measured by audio cross-correlation over three independent 180s windows, r=0.94-0.98, minus the 360s cut point). The filenames implied the opposite sign; they were not used.
